scripts.site: npm run site:watch && node site.mjs dist-site
scripts.site:watch: npm run typecheck && rm -rf dist-site && vite build --mode site --base /watch/ --outDir dist-site/watch && mkdir -p dist-site/replays && cp ../samples/0.2-forager.jsonl.gz dist-site/replays/latest.jsonl.gz
scripts.review: npm run site:watch && rm -rf dist-review && mv dist-site dist-review && node site.mjs dist-review --review
